text_to_speech: in the double displacement reaction of a metal sulphide with an acid we will start out with a small amount of sodium sulphide we'll add an aqueous solution of hydrochloric acid the sodium sulphide and hydrochloric acid react to produce hydrogen sulfide the hydrogen sulfide is released as a gas we can test for the presence of hydrogen sulfide by bringing in a strip of wet lead acetate paper the hydrogen sulphide reacts with the lead acetate paper to form lead sulphide which is a brown black precipitate

timecoded_text_to_speech.text: In the double displacement reaction of a metal sulfide with an acid, we will start out
with a small amount of sodium sulfide.
We will add an aqueous solution of hydrochloric acid.
The sodium sulfide and hydrochloric acid react to produce hydrogen sulfide.
The hydrogen sulfide is released as a gas.
We can test for the presence of hydrogen sulfide by bringing in a strip of wet lead acetate
